'''2003 MegaCon''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Orlando, Florida (1 March 2003). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Orlando, Florida
* '''Dates:''' 1 March 2003
